hypotheses.name: Geodesic manifold advantage for immune regulatory edges
hypotheses.method: Compared geodesic vs Euclidean edge-distance AUROC on immune scGPT residuals (3 seeds x 12 layers x source/target splits) with 200 label-permutation null draws per seed-layer-split.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta +0.00519 (source), +0.01319 (target); dual-split positive 12/12 layers, dual-split significant 7/12
hypotheses.next_action: Replicate the same manifold-distance protocol on lung and external_lung to test cross-domain robustness.

hypotheses.name: Bootstrap persistence stability under filtration perturbations
hypotheses.method: Computed H1 persistence deltas vs feature-shuffle null for immune scGPT across sample-size/PCA settings (120/180 x 10/14), 4 bootstraps per setting, and 24 null draws per bootstrap.
hypotheses.result_value: mean layer delta +3.870; 12/12 layers positive and 12/12 combined Fisher p<0.05; all-settings-positive fraction 1.0
hypotheses.next_action: Add a second stronger null family (metric-preserving surrogate) to test whether stability survives beyond feature-shuffle.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model disagreement trend vs edge positivity
hypotheses.method: Per-domain Spearman trend test between cross-model disagreement magnitude and positive-edge rate across 10 disagreement bins, with 3000 within-domain permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: rho: lung -0.9758 (p=3.33e-4), external_lung -0.5030 (p=0.141), immune +0.4012 (p=0.250); combined Fisher p(two-sided)=8.99e-4
hypotheses.next_action: Resolve domain heterogeneity with per-edge cross-model scores and degree-controlled analysis.
